coverageNote: General Knowledge aur Current Affairs ke mojooda MCQs se wazeh saal wale muntakhib tareekhi waqiat, kitabein, shakhsiyat aur idaray jama kiye gaye hain. BCE ko CE se alag rakha gaya hai.
